      "solution": "def max_removable_boxes(r, c, heights):
    # Compute the three views
    front_view = [max(row) for row in heights]
    top_view = [max(col) for col in zip(*heights)]
    left_view = [max(heights[i][j] for i in range(r)) for j in range(c)]

    # Total boxes in the original grid
    total_boxes = sum(sum(row) for row in heights)

    # Compute the minimal boxes needed to preserve the three views
    minimal_boxes = 0
    for i in range(r):
        for j in range(c):
            minimal_boxes += max(front_view[i], top_view[j], left_view[j])

    # The maximum number of boxes that can be removed
    return total_boxes - minimal_boxes
